title: Workspace bots
subtitle: Automatic users that answer in rooms through a script. They have no password or token.
limitReached: Limit of {{max}} bots per workspace reached.
pickOne: Pick a bot to edit it.

noAccess.title: You cannot manage bots
noAccess.body: The "Manage bots" permission (bots.manage) is required. Ask whoever administers the workspace.

empty.title: No bots yet
empty.body: Create one, or open the help to generate an example bot that answers /hola.

quota.exhausted: Monthly script quota used up: bots will not answer until the next cycle.
quota.used: Script runs this month: {{used}} of {{limit}}. Every bot reply counts.

help.title: How to create a bot with a script
help.step1: Create the bot (name, avatar and description).
help.step2: In the Script tab, create the script from the template or bind one that has a bot trigger (Command, Room message, ...).
help.step3: In the script, the Command trigger delivers the typed arguments and the Reply node answers the message that invoked it.
help.step4: In the Commands tab, register /hola with its arguments so it shows in the composer's autocomplete and is validated before it runs.
help.step5: In the Rooms tab, choose where the bot can view, post and react.
help.limits: A bot only reacts to other bots if you turn that on, and bot chains stop at depth {{depth}}.
help.exampleScript:
Trigger: Command
  command = hola   (nombre, tono)
        |
        v
Action: Reply (as bot)
  text = Hello {options.nombre}! Tone: {options.tono}
  (answers the message that invoked it)

example.created: Example bot created. Try it by typing /hola nombre:Ana in a room.
example.scriptDescription: Answers /hola in the room where it is typed, using the command's options.

failedAt.script: The bot was created, but its script could not be created.
failedAt.bind: The script was created, but it could not be bound to the bot (scripts.manage is required).
failedAt.commands: The bot works, but the command could not be registered.

toast.error: The action could not be completed.

form.name: Name
form.avatarHelp: Without an image the initial is shown on a colour of its own.

errors.name_long: The name can have up to 80 characters.
errors.description_long: The description can have up to 500 characters.
errors.avatar_invalid: The avatar must be an https URL.

detail.hint: A bot only answers while both it and its script are active.

general.activeHint: Pausing it removes it from autocomplete and stops its replies.
general.rolesHint: Its base permissions come from these roles; it cannot have more than you.
general.allowBots: React to messages from other bots
general.allowBotsHint: Off: only people trigger it. Chains stop at depth {{depth}}.

delete.title: Delete bot
delete.description: The bot is removed and stops answering. Its earlier messages are kept with its name and avatar.

commands.intro: Commands /name that show in the composer's autocomplete, with their typed arguments. Registering them does not run them: the bot's script does.
commands.noScript: This bot has no script: the commands will show but nobody will answer.
commands.name: Command name
commands.scriptNote: Each bot has one script. A Command trigger in it answers these commands: the arguments arrive already validated and typed in {options.name}. Old free-text commands still work through the Room message trigger.

errors.invalid: Use 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits, "-" or "_".

script.noPermission: You need the permission to manage scripts
script.noPermissionBody: Binding or creating a bot's script requires scripts.manage in addition to bots.manage.
script.intro: The script runs as the bot. It only accepts data, room, HTTP, JS and AI nodes, with at most one trigger of each kind (message, command, button, reaction, edit, delete, new member, schedule).
script.editorNote: The editor has dedicated nodes for rooms and bots: command with its options, buttons and selects, rich content, reactions, threads, pins and more.
script.noneBody: Create one from the template (answers /hola with typed options) or bind an existing script that has a bot trigger.

rooms.intro: Per room: ✓ allows, – inherits and ✗ denies. "Inherit" uses what the bot's roles and the category give.
rooms.empty: There are no text rooms in this workspace.
rooms.inheritNote: Changes are saved per room and require being able to manage that room.

options.title: Arguments
options.intro: Typed arguments people fill in after the command, like in Discord. Required ones go first. A command has either arguments or subcommands, not both.
options.blockSave: Fix the marked arguments before saving: the server rejects the whole list otherwise.
options.empty: No arguments: the command takes free text, or none.
options.noMixPlain: This command has subcommands; it cannot also take plain arguments.
options.noMixSub: This command has plain arguments; it cannot also have subcommands.
options.name: Argument name

issues.name_invalid: Use 1 to 32 lower-case letters, digits, "-" or "_".
issues.sub_nesting: One level only: group > subcommand > arguments.
issues.group_empty: A group needs at least one subcommand.
issues.choices_count: A fixed list needs 1 to 25 values and only works for text and numbers.
issues.choices_exclusive: A fixed list cannot have minimum, maximum or length limits.
issues.choice_name: Every value needs a label (100 characters at most).
issues.choice_value: Every value needs a value (text up to 100 characters, or a number).
issues.choice_integer: The value must be a whole number.
issues.minmax_number: Minimum and maximum must be numbers.
issues.minmax_integer: Minimum and maximum must be whole numbers.
issues.min_gt_max: The minimum cannot be greater than the maximum.
issues.length_range: Lengths are whole numbers from 0 to {{len}}.
issues.length_order: The minimum length cannot be greater than the maximum.
issues.length_zero_max: The maximum length must be at least 1.
issues.required_order: Required arguments must come before optional ones.
issues.mixed_levels: A command has either subcommands or plain arguments, not both.

locks.botLockedHint: Its identity and settings are frozen: you can only pause, activate or delete it.
locks.codeLockedHint: Nobody can read, edit, export or duplicate its script: you can only pause, activate or delete it.
locks.byPublisher: Locked by the pack's author. It cannot be unlocked, only deleted.
locks.byWorkspace: Only whoever locked it or the workspace owner can unlock it.
locks.lockBotHelp: Freezes its name, description, avatar, commands, triggers and settings. You can still pause and delete it.
locks.lockCodeHelp: Prevents reading, editing, exporting and duplicating its script. You can still pause and delete it.
locks.confirmLockBot: Lock this bot? You will not be able to edit it until whoever locked it or the workspace owner unlocks it.
locks.confirmLockCode: Lock the code? Nobody will be able to read or edit the script until whoever locked it or the workspace owner unlocks it.

errors.SCRIPT_LOCKED: The code of this script is locked.
errors.UNLOCK_FORBIDDEN: You cannot unlock it: it was locked by the pack's author or by someone else.

scriptPane.title: Code locked by the author
scriptPane.body: The editor cannot be opened and the code cannot be read, exported or duplicated. You can still activate, pause or delete it.
scriptPane.bodyWorkspace: The editor cannot be opened and the code cannot be read, exported or duplicated. You can activate, pause or delete it, and unlock it if you locked it or you are the owner.

locks.descriptionFixed: The description and the creator come from the pack and cannot be edited.

author.title: Authorship
author.readOnly: Authorship is read-only and never changes.
